speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Myeloid Leukemia (CML)

The combination of extreme leukocytosis (WBC 81,000), anemia (Hb 8.3), and thrombocytopenia (Platelets 35,600) in a 67-year-old male is highly characteristic of a myeloproliferative neoplasm. To confirm this and rule out acute leukemia or other mimics, please provide the results of a Peripheral Blood Smear to evaluate cell morphology and a Leukocyte Alkaline Phosphatase (LAP) score. I also request images of the blood smear for review.
